base:
Use case: illustration-story
Asset type: transparent sprite atlas for a children's English vocabulary game, ages 6–9.
Primary request: Create an ORIGINAL exactly 40-cell sprite atlas in an INVISIBLE, STRICTLY uniform 8-column by 5-row grid, landscape exactly 8:5 aspect ratio, ideally 2048 by 1280 pixels. Treat every cell as exactly 256x256 at that size. Every sprite is entirely inside its cell with at least 10% empty transparent margin on all sides; center each subject at its cell center. Exactly ONE illustrated subject or single cohesive mini-scene per cell, no duplicate or missing cells. Fill the grid row by row, left to right, in the exact sequence described below. Large readable icons sized consistently.
Style/medium: polished original soft rounded children's cartoon illustration, bright friendly blue, green, orange, yellow palette, clean clear silhouettes, wholesome expressive people, simple readable details, subtly shaded flat digital illustration. All people anatomically gentle and friendly. Adult parents clearly older than children, grandparents visibly elderly with grey hair.
Scene/backdrop: genuine fully transparent alpha across all empty area. Isolated sprites. No page/background color. No global room scene. No floor or ground shadows, no grid lines or borders.
Text: Absolutely no text, no letters, no numerals, no labels, no watermark, no logos, including the blackboard and books.
Constraints: 8 columns EXACTLY, 5 rows EXACTLY. No sprite crossing into neighboring cell. All heads/feet/object edges fully visible, no cropping. Family portraits full bodies. Teacher and classroom are separate different icons. Teacher visibly adult next to a small blank dark green blackboard, classroom is a complete tiny classroom room vignette with several desks and chairs and a blank board contained in that ONE cell. Body part cells use gentle friendly cartoon body portions, no severed realism, no blood; head, arm, leg should make target part especially clear. Eating is food at mouth, drinking cup at mouth; reading is open book held/read, writing is pencil marking blank paper; running dynamic high knee with bent elbows, walking calm stride.
EXACT CELL ASSIGNMENTS:
Row 1, cells 0 to 7: mother; father; brother; sister; grandma; grandpa; baby; friend (two similarly aged children standing smiling together).
Row 2, cells 8 to 15: book; pen; pencil; school bag; school desk; chair; teacher; classroom.
Row 3, cells 16 to 23: head (friendly cartoon child's head); hand (open palm and five fingers); arm (friendly cartoon child's bent arm prominently visible); leg (one friendly cartoon leg prominently visible); foot (friendly cartoon bare foot, gentle); eye (single friendly cartoon eye); nose (single friendly cartoon nose); mouth (single friendly smiling cartoon mouth).
Row 4, cells 24 to 31: child eating; child drinking; child reading; child writing; child sleeping; child playing (playing with toy blocks); child running; child walking.
Row 5, cells 32 to 39: sun; cloud; rain (rain cloud and visible raindrops); snow (snow cloud and snowflakes); wind (clear curved air gust with flying leaves); rainbow (full colorful rainbow arch); hot weather child (child fanning face with visibly hot sun detail); cold weather child (child in winter clothes hugging self with snowflake detail).
BASE VARIANT: Use these distinguishing designs: mother in orange blouse, dark bob hair; father in blue shirt brown short hair; brother green striped t-shirt dark hair; sister yellow dress with brown ponytail; grandma mint dress short grey curly hair; grandpa orange vest with grey hair and moustache; baby yellow onesie. Book blue closed hardcover; pen blue fountain pen; pencil yellow wooden pencil; backpack orange; wooden school desk with blue accents; green chair. Teacher woman with dark hair and blue clothes. Eating child with an apple, drinking child with blue cup, reading green open book, writing with pencil sitting at small orange table, sleeping child under blue blanket in small bed, playing with colorful blocks, running child orange shirt and blue shorts, walking child green shirt yellow shorts. Hot child short sleeves waving a fan; cold child blue jacket and orange wool hat. Distinct clear concept in all 40 cells.
